title: Region-Aware Multi-View Inspection Using Deep Learning and Domain-Informed Decision Fusion

problem.summary: Automated optical inspection of precision components with tiny surface defects remains challenging when different regions of the same component exhibit different defect characteristics and, therefore, different acceptance criteria.
statements: Automated optical inspection of precision components with tiny surface defects remains challenging when different regions of the same component exhibit different defect characteristics and, therefore, different acceptance criteria.

This paper presents a region-aware, dual-model inspection framework that combines instance segmentation of localized seat-region defects with image-level classification of global shaft-region anomalies.

Rather than treating these two model detections as sufficient evidence for component rejection, a deterministic decision fusion layer that formalizes industrial Standard Operating Procedures is applied to the model outputs to make the final component level decision.

On the held-out test split of 261 seat-region images, Model I achieved a precision of 53.24% (TP = 501, FP = 440), an instance-level recall of 37.19% (FN = 846), an F1-score of 43.79%, and a mean boundingbox IoU of 0.7069 among correctly matched defect candidates.
